requirement: Validate an update-antibiotic command: the antibiotic ID and name must not be empty or whitespace, the antibiotic group ID must not be empty, and the classification must be a defined enum member.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access

inputs.text: Valid update of Amoxicillin with classification Access
Valid update of Meropenem with classification Watch
Empty name with otherwise valid fields
Whitespace-only name with otherwise valid fields
Guid.Empty as the antibiotic group ID
Empty ID, empty name, empty group, and classification 999

returns.text: Single validation error reported on Id, Name, AntibioticGroupId, or Classification
Four violations reported for four invalid fields

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
